vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where doctors see patients
vocabulary.example: I went to the clinic this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how hot or cold something is
something you take to get better

vocabulary.example: Take it three times a day after meals.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea about what someone should do
a nose with liquid coming out
a sound when air comes out of your throat

vocabulary.example: How long have you had these symptoms?

fine_lines.title: headache vs sore throat
fine_lines.explanation_ar: headache ألم في الرأس، و sore throat ألم في الحلق. نقول: I have a headache. I have a sore throat.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Headache = pain in the head. Sore throat = pain in the throat.

fine_lines.title: fever vs cold
fine_lines.explanation_ar: fever ارتفاع حرارة الجسم، و cold مرض بسيط (زكام) مع سيلان أنف وسعال.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Fever = high temperature. Cold = a common illness with a runny nose and cough.

examples.sentence: Your temperature is 38 degrees. You have a fever.
I have a runny nose. I think I have a cold.

expressions.meaning_en: Tell a doctor you are sick.
expressions.example: Hello, doctor. I don't feel well.

expressions.phrase: What is wrong? / What is the problem?
expressions.example: Hello, Mark. What is the problem?

expressions.phrase: How long have you felt this way? — For two days.
expressions.meaning_ar: منذ متى تشعر هكذا؟ — منذ يومين.
expressions.meaning_en: Ask how long a problem has lasted.
expressions.example: How long have you felt this way? For three days.

expressions.meaning_en: What a doctor or nurse says.
expressions.example: Sit down, please. Let me check your temperature.

expressions.meaning_ar: ماذا يجب أن أفعل يا دكتور؟
expressions.example: I have a fever. What should I do, doctor?

expressions.phrase: Take the medicine three times a day after meals.
expressions.meaning_ar: تناول الدواء ثلاث مرات يوميًا بعد الوجبات.
expressions.example: Take the medicine twice a day after meals.

expressions.meaning_en: Agree to do what the doctor says.
expressions.example: Thank you, doctor. I will follow your advice.

expressions.phrase: If you don't feel better, come back.
expressions.meaning_ar: إذا لم تتحسّن فعُد مرة أخرى.
expressions.meaning_en: Tell a patient to return if needed.
expressions.example: Rest at home. If you don't feel better, come back.

expressions.phrase: The doctor is ready to see you now.
expressions.example: Mark, the doctor is ready to see you now.

grammar.title: Describing symptoms: I have a + illness/symptom
grammar.explanation_ar: نصف الأعراض بـ I have a + اسم: I have a headache. I have a sore throat. I have a runny nose and a cough.
grammar.explanation_en: Describe symptoms: I have a headache / a sore throat / a cough.
examples: I have a headache and a sore throat.
I have a runny nose and a cough.
Do you have a fever? No, I don't.

grammar.title: How long have you...? — For + time
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن المدة بالمضارع التام: How long have you felt this way? How long have you had these symptoms? والجواب: For two days.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask duration with the present perfect: How long have you had...? Answer: For + time.
examples: How long have you felt this way? For two days.
How long have you had these symptoms? For three days.
I have had a cough for a week.

grammar.title: need to / should for instructions
grammar.explanation_ar: need to + الفعل (يجب/يلزم) و should + الفعل (ينبغي) لتعليمات الطبيب: You need to rest. You should stay at home.
grammar.explanation_en: Doctor's instructions: You need to + verb / You should + verb.
examples: You need to rest and drink a lot of water.
You should stay at home and rest.

questions.question: I have a ___. My head hurts.
questions.explanation_en: A headache is pain in the head.

questions.question: How long have you felt this way? — ___ two days.
questions.explanation_en: Use "for" with a length of time.

Do you have a fever? — No, I ___.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال بـ Do، فالجواب No, I don't.
